description: Ministry of Tourism & Sports - Sports Act. No. 25 of 1973 - Navin Eranjan Dissanayake Minister of Tourism & Sports appoint 07 persons from 15th May 2015 to 15th July 2015 in order to carryout the functions of Sri Lanka Judo Association until an election is held on further notice
reasoning: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (Navin Eranjan Dissanayake and multiple appointees) AND detailed portfolio responsibilities (Minister of Tourism and Sports, with powers under specific sections of the Sports Act).
